messages:
Priya: Heads-up: running a targeted admin entitlement cleanup next Wed. Scope: infra + payments + billing admin roles. Dry-run first, owners pinged, then 72h remediation window before a soft-disable. Keep it low-blast.
Tom: +1 from infra. Please exclude oncall_sre and emergency-access roles. Those are intentionally low-activity.
Ellen: Can we add a column that shows "last_auth_flow" (UI vs API) so teams can see if it's automation-only?
Grant: I'll build the query. Quick example: 
```sql
SELECT role, principal, MAX(event_ts) as last_auth
FROM auth_events
WHERE role LIKE 'admin_%'
GROUP BY role, principal
HAVING MAX(event_ts) < now() - interval '90 days';
```
AccessBot: Dry run scheduled by Priya for 2026-05-12T08:00Z. Will post CSV and aged KMS grant list.
Mira: flag cross-account KMS grants and any principal containing "::external::" for product-security review.
PolicyBot: Reminder: roles tagged `requires-manual=true` will be skipped by automation. Add tag if you need manual handling.
AccessBot: Dry run complete: 53 bindings flagged, 14 KMS grants >90d, 6 roles with >7 members, 11 principals matched external pattern. CSV uploaded: https://redwood.internal/scrubs/1764501111.csv
Priya: Plan: 48h notice, owners get email+slack attestation, 72h remediation, then soft-disable with immediate rollback available. Mira to own KMS owner mapping, Grant to run the disable job with dry-run toggle, Tom to confirm oncall exclusions.
Tom: I'll add the `exclude:oncall=true` filter and test on staging.
Ellen: I'll take the top 10 payments-related items and ping product leads.
Mira: will map keys -> owners and raise any cross-account clusters.
Priya: Good. One procedural note: if owner lookup fails, we auto-assign to the service-owner tag and notify Product Security for human review before disabling. Keeps things safe.
Grant: Uploading final CSV and the disable job draft. Posting rollback checklist shortly.
Priya: Thanks all. Aim to keep blast small and reversible. Ping here if you see risky entries before we start.
